name: MonarchAiUserMessageEdit
title: AiUserMessageEdit
summary: An inline editor for a prompt the person already sent: a multi-line field, a note that resending starts a new branch, and Cancel and Send buttons.
whenToUse: In place of a sent user message when the person chooses to edit it.
whenNotToUse: For writing a new message use the prompt input of the conversation. For editing other text use MonarchTextField.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiUserMessageEdit(original: String, onSubmit: (String) -> Unit, onCancel: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, maxLines: Int = 10, focusOnAppear: Boolean = true, label: String? = null, branchHint: String? = null, sendLabel: String? = null, cancelLabel: String? = null)

options.name: original
options.description: The prompt as it was sent. The field starts with it.

options.name: onSubmit
options.description: Called with the trimmed text when the user sends it.

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Called when the user cancels. Leave edit mode here.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field and buttons can be used.

options.name: maxLines
options.description: The lines the field grows to before it scrolls. At least 2.

options.name: focusOnAppear
options.description: Moves focus into the field, caret at the end, when the editor appears.

options.name: branchHint
options.description: Replaces the note that resending keeps the original.

states.name: unchanged or empty
states.description: Send is disabled: the trimmed text is empty or equal to the trimmed original.

states.name: changed
states.description: Send is the primary button and calls onSubmit with the trimmed text.

states.name: focused
states.description: The field's border takes the focus ring color.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field uses the subtle fill and disabled text, and both buttons are disabled.

appearance: The field is a Material 3 outlined field in the Monarch text field colors: surface fill, input border, focus ring color while focused. The note uses the muted text color. Cancel is a ghost button and Send a primary button, in every theme.
platformNotes: On the web Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. On Android Return adds a line, as in every multi-line field, so Send is a button; with a hardware keyboard Ctrl+Enter (or Meta+Enter) sends and Escape cancels. The web's hidden keyboard hint is therefore not offered. The field starts two lines high. The text is held by the component and starts again from original when original changes; it survives configuration changes.
accessibility: The field's content description is "Edit message" (or label).
The branch note is the field's supporting text, shown under it and read with it.
Send is disabled, and exposed as disabled, until the text can be resent.
Both buttons keep a 48dp touch target; they wrap onto a second line when they do not fit.
Cancel comes before Send in reading order in both layout directions.
edgeCases: Leading and trailing white space and line breaks are trimmed before comparing and before onSubmit.
A maxLines below 2 is treated as 2.
Text longer than maxLines scrolls inside the field.
focusOnAppear raises the keyboard as soon as the editor is shown; a disabled editor does not take focus.

examples.title: Edit and resend
examples.template:
MonarchAiUserMessageEdit(
    original = message,
    onSubmit = { text -> message = text },
    onCancel = {},
    focusOnAppear = false,
    modifier = Modifier.widthIn(max = 576.dp),
)
